contracts.distance_units: F833/F3007 integer hundredths of a light year; original truncation, not continuous Euclidean replacement
contracts.mass: F903 uses signed spec word+6 only, no cargo/equipment addition and no zero fallback; F902 substitutes1 for zero mass
contracts.drive_field8: F902 capacity threshold/F911 salvage quantity; do not use as installation mass
contracts.installation_mass: DATA7210 equals actual DATA5289 engine-record DWORD+8; F390 subtracts equipment mass from DATA8889
contracts.cargo: D8896 is38 cargoWORDs; D8901 hydrogen commodity19, D8902 military20, D8903 radioactive waste29; all are separate from PhysObj+11E jetfuel
contracts.military_waste: F903 mode2 drive>=10 consumes D8902 and adds same amount to D8903; normal hydrogen mode decreases occupied cargo D8891
contracts.equipment: F998 aggregate capacity decrement excludes cargo counted independently in D8891; fixed_equipment_space_t is decrement minus installed drive mass, not a reconstructed full inventory
contracts.compatibility: Profiles are opt-in NEW session adapters; no old-save or registry-alias migration
contracts.scope: 57 raw specifications support quote lookup; they do not make57 playable ships or reproduce the full outfitting economy
